activities.name: CALCULUS
activities.mode: written, closed book; oral possible at the board's request
activities.notes: Published theory-question lists per year make the theory half predictable, but Part 1 carries its own 15/30 minimum on top of the overall 18.

activities.name: COMPUTER PROGRAMMING, ALGORITHMS AND DATA STRUCTURES
activities.mode: mod.2 written (theory + Python); mod.1 project OR computer-based test
activities.notes: Two independent minimums on module 2 and an automatic fail for non-running code. The module 1 project option reduces risk but adds a deliverable.

activities.name: THEORETICAL AND QUANTUM PHYSICS FOR AI
activities.notes: 12 CFU split across two universities and examined independently; physics-heavy. Rated on structure, not on rules.

activities.name: COMPUTATIONAL LOGIC
activities.notes: Solved exams for every session 2022-2026 in the Exam_Assignments folders. Nothing else to satisfy.

activities.name: COGNITIVE PSYCHOLOGY
activities.mode: written (25 pts: 5 MCQ + 20 open) + oral (6 pts), both compulsory
activities.notes: Compulsory oral gated behind a written threshold. Subject is approachable; structure is not. Which threshold binds depends on which edition you sit under.

activities.name: ETHICS, LAW AND AI
activities.notes: 12 CFU, three lecturers, essayistic subject. Rated on subject type alone, which is weak.

activities.name: KNOWLEDGE REPRESENTATION AND REASONING
activities.notes: Both modules publish solved papers, and the mean lets a strong module carry a weak one - but it is 12 CFU and two sittings.

activities.name: PROBABILITY AND STATISTICAL INFERENCE
activities.mode: written in computer lab, open + closed items
activities.notes: Largest solved archive in the plan (Jan 2023 - Feb 2025), but 12 CFU across two modules.

activities.name: BRAIN MODELLING
activities.notes: Cannot rate on evidence. All three Kiro editions contain a forum and nothing else.

activities.name: STATISTICAL MODELLING
activities.notes: Cannot rate on evidence. All three Kiro editions contain a forum and nothing else.

activities.name: TEXT MINING AND NATURAL LANGUAGE PROCESSING
activities.mode: written, open + closed questions, up to 32 points
activities.notes: Well covered by three years of samples, but negative marking punishes the guess-everything strategy that a bare 18 usually relies on.

activities.name: MACHINE LEARNING, ARTIFICIAL NEURAL NETWORKS AND DEEP LEARNING
activities.mode: upload (Colab notebook + PDF) on the session date
activities.notes: Take-home style coding with two published mock assignments in identical format; not a closed-book paper.

activities.name: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE FOR COMMUNICATION AND MARKETING
activities.notes: 'Lab exam assignment - 2026 Summer session' folder contains AI4CM_LabExam_Part1/2/3.pdf plus data.xlsx and marketing_campaign.csv, so the exam is applied lab work on supplied data.

activities.name: DATA MINING AND KNOWLEDGE EXTRACTION
activities.notes: 12 of 30 points bankable before the written part, which is then scaled into 18.

activities.name: FUZZY SYSTEMS AND EVOLUTIONARY COMPUTING
activities.notes: Question types recur verbatim year to year with published model answers; lab samples solved.

activities.name: ORGANIZATION THEORY AND DESIGN
activities.notes: Free-choice course outside the AI degree; 27 slide decks per edition but no rules statement.

coursework_in_parallel.name: FINAL EXAM
coursework_in_parallel.mode: report + presentation to the degree board
coursework_in_parallel.notes: Rules come from the Final examination regulations, not Kiro. 3 CFU but gated on a supervisor and a deadline.

coursework_in_parallel.name: INFORMATION RETRIEVAL AND RECOMMENDER SYSTEMS
coursework_in_parallel.notes: No sitting to schedule; published instructions, templates and dataset code. Overlaps with Web and social media.

coursework_in_parallel.name: LABORATORY OF MACHINE LEARNING
coursework_in_parallel.notes: No exam. Deadline-driven, so it runs alongside exam preparation.

coursework_in_parallel.name: PROJECT WORK
coursework_in_parallel.notes: Kiro page carries a proposals database rather than rules; appelli exist in Sep, Oct and Dec, which is unusually flexible.

coursework_in_parallel.name: WEB AND SOCIAL MEDIA SEARCH AND ANALYSIS
coursework_in_parallel.notes: Project instructions found with 'Deadline: at least 7 days before the written examination', so both components exist.
